angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 516,209 km at 46.26 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 21.6179 +/- 0.0148 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 46.26 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.742 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Lowson et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 113103 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract): 516,209 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.761 +/- 0.038 solar masses from Lowson et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HIP 113103 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4930 +/- 100 K from Lowson et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 113103 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lowson et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HIP 113103 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hip-113103.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.579, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 113103 (pscomppars): [M/H] -0.1 dex, from Lowson et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 113103 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.57629, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 113103 (pscomppars): age 0.47 Gyr, from Lowson et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 113103 (pscomppars): rotation period 9.92 d, from Lowson et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HIP 113103 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Lowson et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.527.1146L/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.742 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.793. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
